Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] All of your Digimon get +1000 DP.
